78009-a-guide-to-the-history-of-physical.title: Physical Education
78009-a-guide-to-the-history-of-physical.creator: Fred Eugene Leonard, A.M., M.D.
78009-a-guide-to-the-history-of-physical.description: A book by Fred Eugene Leonard, A.M., M.D.. The year also contributed to the linguistic knowledge and experience needed for the handling of such material. The direct contact with historic spots and significant aspects of physical education in Europe which it brought was afterwards renewed and broadened by five months (February to June, 1913) spent at important centers in Switzerland, Germany, the three Scandinavian countries, and Great Britain.

arxiv-1607-05969.title: 4D Cardiac Ultrasound Standard Plane Location by Spatial-Temporal Correlation
arxiv-1607-05969.creator: Yun Gu, Guang-Zhong Yang, Jie Yang, Kun Sun
arxiv-1607-05969.description: Abstract Echocardiography plays an important part in diagnostic aid in cardiac diseases. A critical step in echocardiography-aided diagnosis is to extract the standard planes since they tend to provide promising views to present different structures that are benefit to diagnosis.

arxiv-2103-17249.title: StyleCLIP: Text-Driven Manipulation of StyleGAN Imagery
arxiv-2103-17249.creator: Or Patashnik Zongze Wu Eli Shechtman Daniel Cohen-Or Dani Lischinski
arxiv-2103-17249.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Or Patashnik Zongze Wu Eli Shechtman Daniel Cohen-Or Dani Lischinski. Inspired by the ability of StyleGAN to generate highly realistic images in a variety of domains, much recent work has focused on understanding how to use the latent spaces of StyleGAN to manipulate generated and real images. However, discovering semantically meaningful latent manipulations typically involves painstaking human examination of the many degrees of freedom, or an annotated collection of images for each desired manipulation.

arxiv-2105-02379.title: Targeted Quality Measurement of Health Care Providers Thanks: The authors thank Ambarish Chattopadhyay, Michael Chernew, Richard Frank, Avi Feller, Luke Keele, Bijan Niknam, and Alan Zaslavsky for helpful comments and conversations. This study used the linked SEER-Medicare database. The interpretati
arxiv-2105-02379.creator: Yige Li, Nancy L. Keating, Mary Beth Landrum, José R. Zubizarreta
arxiv-2105-02379.description: Abstract Assessing the quality of cancer care administered by US health providers poses numerous challenges due to meaningful heterogeneity in patient populations. Patients undergoing oncology treatment exhibit substantial variation in disease presentation among other crucial characteristics. In this paper, we present a framework for institutional quality measurement that addresses this patient heterogeneity.

arxiv-2106-00675.title: Quantum crosstalk cancellation for fast entangling gates and improved multi-qubit performance
arxiv-2106-00675.creator: K. X. Wei, E. Magesan, I. Lauer, S. Srinivasan, D. F. Bogorin, S. Carnevale, G. A. Keefe, Y. Kim, D. Klaus, W. Landers, N. Sundaresan, C. Wang, E. J. Zhang, M. Steffen, O. E. Dial, D. C. McKay, A. Kandala
arxiv-2106-00675.description: Abstract Quantum computers built with superconducting artificial atoms already stretch the limits of their classical counterparts. While the lowest energy states of these artificial atoms serve as the qubit basis, the higher levels are responsible for both a host of attractive gate schemes as well as generating undesired interactions.

arxiv-2311-01591.title: Better Fair than Sorry: Adversarial Missing Sensitive Value Imputation for Fair GNNs
arxiv-2311-01591.creator: Debolina Halder Lina, Arlei Silva
arxiv-2311-01591.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art results in many relevant tasks where decisions might disproportionately impact specific communities. However, existing work on fair GNNs often assumes that either protected attributes are fully observed or that the missing protected attribute imputation is fair.

arxiv-2402-11841.title: ASGNet: Adaptive Semantic Gate Networks for Log-Based Anomaly Diagnosis
arxiv-2402-11841.creator: Haitian Yang(✉), Degang Sun(✉), Wen Liu, Yanshu Li, Yan Wang, Weiqing Huang
arxiv-2402-11841.description: Abstract Logs are widely used in the development and maintenance of software systems. Logs can help engineers understand the runtime behavior of systems and diagnose system failures. For anomaly diagnosis, existing methods generally use log event data extracted from historical logs to build diagnostic models.

arxiv-2402-16268.title: Foundation Model Transparency Reports
arxiv-2402-16268.creator: Rishi Bommasani, Kevin Klyman, Shayne Longpre, Betty Xiong, Sayash Kapoor, Nestor Maslej, Arvind Narayanan, Percy Liang
arxiv-2402-16268.description: Abstract . Foundation models are critical digital technologies with sweeping societal impact that necessitates transparency. To codify how foundation model developers should provide transparency about the development and deployment of their models, we propose Foundation Model Transparency Reports, drawing upon the transparency reporting practices in social media.

arxiv-2408-12420.title: Dataset ∣ \mid Mindset = Explainable AI ∣ \mid Interpretable AI
arxiv-2408-12420.creator: C ​ a ​ e ​ s ​ a ​ r ​ W ​ u a , R ​ a ​ j ​ k ​ u ​ m ​ a ​ r ​ B ​ u ​ y ​ y ​ a b , Y ​ u ​ a ​ n ​ F ​ a ​ n ​ g ​ L ​ i c , P ​ a ​ s ​ c ​ a ​ l ​ B ​ o ​ u ​ v ​ r ​ y a CaesarWu^{a},RajkumarBuyya^{b},YuanFangLi^{c},PascalBouvry^{a}
arxiv-2408-12420.description: Abstract We often use "explainable" Artificial Intelligence (XAI)" and "interpretable AI (IAI)" interchangeably when we apply various XAI tools for a given dataset to explain the reasons that underpin machine learning (ML) outputs. However, these notions can sometimes be confusing because interpretation often has a subjective connotation, while explanations lean towards objective facts.

arxiv-2501-17799.title: Leveraging Multimodal LLM for Inspirational User Interface Search
arxiv-2501-17799.creator: Seokhyeon Park, Yumin Song, Soohyun Lee, Jaeyoung Kim, Jinwook Seo
arxiv-2501-17799.description: Abstract . Inspirational search, the process of exploring designs to inform and inspire new creative work, is pivotal in mobile user interface (UI) design. However, exploring the vast space of UI references remains a challenge. Existing AI-based UI search methods often miss crucial semantics like target users or the mood of apps.

arxiv-2511-18133.title: Full calibration of the tomographic redshift distribution from the HSC PDR3 Shape Catalog with DESI
arxiv-2511-18133.creator: R. Zhou
arxiv-2511-18133.description: Abstract The calibration of tomographic redshift distributions is essential for cosmological analysis of weak lensing data. In this work, we calibrate all four tomographic bins of the Hyper Suprime Camera (HSC) weak lensing catalog with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Data Release 1 and 2 using the clustering redshifts technique. We include z > 1.2 z>1.

arxiv-2602-02977.title: Aligning Forest and Trees in Images and Long Captions for Visually Grounded Understanding
arxiv-2602-02977.creator: Byeongju Woo, Zilin Wang, Byeonghyun Pak, Sangwoo Mo, Stella X. Yu
arxiv-2602-02977.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Byeongju Woo, Zilin Wang, Byeonghyun Pak, Sangwoo Mo, Stella X. Yu. Large vision-language models such as CLIP struggle with long captions because they align images and texts as undifferentiated wholes. Fine-grained vision-language understanding requires hierarchical semantics capturing both global context and localized details across visual and textual domains. Yet linguistic hierarchies from syntax or semantics rarely match visual organization, and purely visual hierarchies tend to fragment scenes into appearance-driven parts without semantic focus.

pmc-10606122.title: The Gelatin-Coated Nanostructured Lipid Carrier (NLC) Containing Salvia officinalis Extract: Optimization by Combined D-Optimal Design and Its Application to Improve the Quality Parameters of Beef Burger
pmc-10606122.creator: Maedeh Malekmohammadi, Babak Ghanbarzadeh, Shahram Hanifian, Hossein Samadi Kafil, Mehdi Gharekhani, Pasquale M. Falcone
pmc-10606122.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The current study aims to synthesize the gelatin-coated nanostructured lipid carrier (NLC) to encapsulate sage extract and use this nanoparticle to increase the quality parameters of beef burger samples. NLCs were prepared by formulation of gelatin (as surfactant and coating biopolymer), tallow oil (as solid lipid), rosemary essential oil (as liquid lipid), sage extract (as active material or encapsulant), polyglycerol ester and Tween 80 (as low-molecular emulsifier) through the high-shear homogenization–sonication method.

pmc-10696664.title: Preliminary results of the effect of music therapy treatment on anxiety, sadness, physical discomfort, mood, and quality of life in hospitalized onco-haematological patients
pmc-10696664.creator: Patricia Martí, Irene Fontanals, Joel Funtané, Cristina Canaletas, Jorge Sierra, Mariona Rodés, Melissa Mercadal-Brotons, Iria González, Silvana Novelli
pmc-10696664.description: BackgroundPhysical and psychological distress may occur in patients facing an onco-haematological diagnosis and undergoing complex therapies such as intensive chemotherapy, stem cell transplantation, and immunotherapy. Studies have shown the need for incorporating different therapeutic modalities to respond to patients’ physical and psychosocial needs.

pmc-10745766.title: Health Economic Evaluation of a Controlled Lifestyle Intervention: The Healthy Lifestyle Community Program (Cohort 2; HLCP-2)
pmc-10745766.creator: Ragna-Marie Kranz, Carmen Kettler, Christian Koeder, Sarah Husain, Corinna Anand, Nora Schoch, Heike Englert, Rosa Casas
pmc-10745766.description: Non-communicable diseases (NCD) are associated with high costs for healthcare systems. We evaluated changes in total costs, comprising direct and indirect costs, due to a 24-month non-randomized, controlled lifestyle intervention trial with six measurement time points aiming to improve the risk profile for NCDs.

pmc-11387655.title: Maid gene dysfunction promotes hyperobesity via the reduction of adipose tissue inflammation in Mc4r gene-deficient mice
pmc-11387655.creator: Kyutaro Koyama, Akira Sakamaki, Shinichi Morita, Itsuo Nagayama, Marina Kudo, Yuto Tanaka, Naruhiro Kimura, Yoshihisa Arao, Hiroyuki Abe, Kenya Kamimura, Shuji Terai
pmc-11387655.description: The onset and progression mechanisms of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) are being studied. We developed and analyzed a new mouse model of obesity by combining maternal Id-like molecule (Maid) and melanocortin-4 receptor (Mc4r) gene deletions.

pmc-11509844.title: Effects of Different Additives and Ratios on Broom Sorghum Straw Silage Characteristics and Bacterial Communities
pmc-11509844.creator: Panjie Sheng, Baochao Bai, Mingjian Liu, Weiqin Ma, Jianliang Liu, Chaoran Song, Shuai Du, Gentu Ge, Yushan Jia, Zhijun Wang
pmc-11509844.description: As a large agricultural country, China produces a large number of agricultural and sideline products while harvesting agricultural products every year. Crop straw is one of them. Broom sorghum is a traditional crop in China, which produces a large amount of straw resources every year. These straw resources are placed in the field and cannot be used efficiently.

pmc-11618609.title: Child’s friendly dental attire, a game changer for anxiety and pain management in dental environment, a randomized clinical trial
pmc-11618609.creator: Jamila Bchara, Dajma Abed, Mohannad Laflouf, Snaa Massoud, Jina Alfeel, Dani Abed
pmc-11618609.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Dental anxiety usually stands in the way of obtaining adequate dental treatment, and the dental setting and team are considered factors that may affect dental anxiety. Many cross-sectional studies have indicated that dentally anxious children prefer their dentist to wear friendly attire rather than a conventional white coat, but no clinical trial has detected the effect of wearing a child’s friendly attire on anxiety levels among young patients.

pmc-11672018.title: Histological features of liver disease development in the Atp7b−/− mouse: a model of Wilson’s disease
pmc-11672018.creator: Pierre-Marie Lavrut, Olivier Guillaud, Jérôme Dumortier, Elisabeth Mintz, Virginie Brun, Sophie Heissat, Eduardo Couchonnal Bedoya, Alain Lachaux, Muriel Bost, Valerie Hervieu
pmc-11672018.description: AimsWilson’s disease (WD) is caused by mutations in the ATP7B gene, resulting in copper accumulation and toxicity in liver and brain tissues. Due to the initial asymptomatic liver involvement, the progression of liver injuries in WD stays primarily unknown. Atp7b−/− knockout mice have been shown to be an appropriate model of WD for liver involvement.

pmc-11960229.title: Precision diagnosis and treatment of vitamin metabolism-related epilepsy
pmc-11960229.creator: Yajing Gan, Guoyan Li, Zihan Wei, Yan Feng, Yuqing Shi, Yanchun Deng
pmc-11960229.description: Epilepsy is a chronic disorder of the nervous system caused by abnormal discharges from brain cells. Structural, infectious, metabolic, immunologic, and unknown causes can contribute to the development of seizures. In recent years, there has been increasing attention on epilepsy caused by genetic metabolic disorders.

pmc-12522970.title: Novel use of stereotactic ablative radiotherapy for refractory ventricular tachycardia with cardiac metastasis of primary renal cell carcinoma: a case report
pmc-12522970.creator: Olivier Cravéreau, A Stefani, I Buchheit, T Loustaud, A Grimon, W Gehin, N Martz, M Bruand, C Simon, V Marchesi, C De Chillou, JM Sellal, JC Faivre
pmc-12522970.description: BackgroundAlthough rare, cardiac metastases are increasingly reported in oncology. Surgery may be an option for selected patients, but is often not feasible due to high postoperative morbidity. Radiotherapy therefore emerges as a non-invasive local treatment, either as a primary or adjuvant approach, similar to its use in other palliative settings.

pmc-12572496.title: Study the characterization and thermoelectrical properties of the polyvinyl alcohol / Polyaniline polymer blend thick films
pmc-12572496.creator: M A Morad, M S Abo Ghazala, M G El-Shaarawy, M E Gouda, T Y Elrasasi
pmc-12572496.description: This study investigated the impact of the introduction of Polyaniline (PANi) on the structural, thermal stability, electrical, and thermoelectric properties of polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)1−x Polyaniline (PANi)x blend composites, (where x = 0, 10, 20, and 30 wt.%). The prepared blends were synthesized via the casting technique. The process of polymerizing polyaniline (PANi) was executed in a methodical and ordered manner.

pmc-12610691.title: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Using Denoising Multi-Channel Mixture of CNN and Mamba-Enhanced Adaptive Self-Attention LSTM
pmc-12610691.creator: Songjiang Lai, Tsun-Hin Cheung, Ka-Chun Fung, Kaiwen Xue, Jiayi Zhao, Hana Lebeta Goshu, Zihang Lyu, Kin-Man Lam, Pavlos Lazaridis, Christos Tachtatzis, Euler Cássio Tavares De Macêdo
pmc-12610691.description: Recent advancements in deep learning have significantly improved fault diagnosis methods. However, challenges such as insufficient feature extraction, limited long-range dependency modeling, and environmental noise continue to hinder their effectiveness. This paper presents a novel mixture of multi-view convolutional (MOM-Conv) layers integrating the Mixture of Experts (MOE) mechanism.

pmc-12712311.title: Impact of recently initiated medications on the incidence of urinary tract infections in patients with type 2 diabetes: an observational case-control study
pmc-12712311.creator: Joseph Ben Hill, Alexis Simons, Garth Wright, Kelly E Anderson
pmc-12712311.description: Background:Patients with type 2 diabetes (T2DM) are at risk of developing urinary tract infections (UTIs). Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) are a common medication associated with UTIs in these patients. However, emerging data show that other medications may be more frequently prescribed prior to UTI diagnosis.

pmc-12830978.title: The beta1-adrenergic receptor in the heart
pmc-12830978.creator: Wenchao Xu, Jie Li, Jie Ju, Min Liu, Wenxu Wang, Min Cheng, Xiaoyun Zhang, Xiaodong Cui, Hao Chen
pmc-12830978.description: beta1-adrenergic receptor (β1-AR) belongs to G protein-coupled receptors, regulating cardiac physiological and pathological process through complex signaling pathways. Physiologically, the activation of β1-AR produces positive chronotropic, positive inotropic and positive dromotropic effects in the heart. However, excessive or sustained activation of β1-AR can cause myocardial injury, arrhythmias, and heart failure.

pmc-13081236.title: Correlation of retinal imaging with presence of inner limiting membrane pores in idiopathic epiretinal gliosis
pmc-13081236.creator: Denise Vogt, Nikolina Durdevic, Azza Dammak, Ricarda G. Schumann, Andrea Govetto, Mario R. Romano, Efstathios Vounotrypidis, Melih Parlak, Armin Wolf
pmc-13081236.description: BackgroundTo correlate retinal imaging biomarkers in idiopathic epiretinal membranes (iERM) with histopathological findings of internal limiting membrane (ILM) pores.MethodsWe retrospectively included 18 eyes of 18 patients diagnosed with iERM that underwent vitrectomy with membrane peeling between October 2023 and June 2024 at the Department of Ophthalmology, University Hospital Ulm, Germany.

pmc-13262167.title: Crankshaft Phenomenon After Definitive Spinal Fusion in Pre-teens: Should We Be Concerned with Pedicle Screw Constructs?
pmc-13262167.creator: Jake H. Goldfarb, Eshan S. Sane, Christian E. Wright, Nicholas C. Speller, Ling Chen, Simon Y. Tang, Keith H. Bridwell, Blake K. Montgomery
pmc-13262167.description: BackgroundBecause of remaining growth, early spinal fusion can lead to the crankshaft phenomenon, which occurs when continued growth of the anterior spine after posterior fusion causes curve progression. This project aims to explore the impact of early fusion on crankshaft.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted of idiopathic scoliosis patients aged 8-12 treated with posterior spinal fusion.

pmc-13290711.title: Daratumumab as rescue therapy in refractory recurrent FSGS after kidney transplantation: a case series
pmc-13290711.creator: Parthenopi Despina Avaniadi, Aylin Akifova, Eva Vanessa Schrezenmeier, Sophie Lüdemann, Georgios Eleftheriadis, Ayse Selin Güneytepe, Linde Gao, Friederike Bachmann, Felicitas E. pmc-13456283.title: Job crafting and innovative behavior among nurses: The serial mediating effect of team psychological safety and perceived organizational support
pmc-13456283.creator: XuYan Liu, RenLong Liang, Jijun Wu, Yin Yuan, YiWei Li, Tingting Ruan, Heng Ding, Tingting Cai, Vinit Ramawat, Vinit Ramawat, Vinit Ramawat
pmc-13456283.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Nurses’ innovative behavior plays an important role in improving nursing quality and patient safety. Although job crafting has been reported to be associated with innovative behavior, the underlying mechanisms among nurses remain insufficiently understood. This study aimed to examine the associations among job crafting, team psychological safety, perceived organizational support, and innovative behavior, as well as the individual and serial mediating associations of team psychological safety and perceived organizational support.
